'''Morel''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Drall/Legends|Drall]] [[Beastmaster/Legends|beast master]] residing on the [[Carrick Station]] during the [[Galactic War]], a conflict fought between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] after their [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|uneasy truce]] broke down.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Beastmaster Morel was added to ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' in Update 4.0. as an NPC on the fleet, who starts a short mission while unlocking multiple creature companions from the Cartel Market.

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' {{1st}}
